ai_summary: Allcargo Global Limited's August 2026 operational update indicates a strategic rationalization, with LCL volumes down 7% year-on-year due to the deliberate exit from loss-making trade lanes, aimed at improving yields. While FCL and Air volumes also saw year-on-year declines (5% and 6% respectively), the company demonstrated strong operational efficiency through improved container utilization and increased 40-foot container usage. The outlook for LCL freight rates remains positive due to expected resilient peak season demand and constrained capacity.
